6bdac3d2b401b1e6ba37a0c8ad5b9a5711210733.sourceSql:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'u:'||user_id ELSE 'g:'||guest_id END) FROM play_sessions WHERE game_id=?) AS unique_players,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM play_sessions WHERE game_id=?) AS sessions,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(duration_seconds),0) FROM play_sessions WHERE game_id=?) AS total_play_seconds,
  (SELECT ROUND(AVG(rating)::numeric,2) FROM ratings WHERE game_id=?) AS average_rating,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ratings WHERE game_id=?) AS ratings_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE game_id=? AND parent_id IS NULL) AS reviews_count,
  (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_seconds) FROM play_sessions WHERE game_id=? AND duration_seconds>0) AS median_seconds,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM game_events WHERE game_id=? AND event_type IN ('game_click','custom_click')) AS clicks,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM game_events WHERE game_id=? AND event_type='catalog_click') AS catalog_clicks,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM game_events WHERE game_id=? AND event_type='game_open' AND source='external') AS external_referrals,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorites WHERE game_id=?) AS favorites,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM game_events WHERE game_id=? AND event_type='game_shared') AS share_events,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE('u:'||user_id,'g:'||guest_id)) FROM game_events WHERE game_id=? AND event_type='game_shared') AS shared_players
6bdac3d2b401b1e6ba37a0c8ad5b9a5711210733.sql:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'u:'||user_id ELSE 'g:'||guest_id END) FROM play_sessions WHERE game_id=$1) AS unique_players,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM play_sessions WHERE game_id=$2) AS sessions,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(duration_seconds),0) FROM play_sessions WHERE game_id=$3) AS total_play_seconds,
  (SELECT ROUND(AVG(rating)::numeric,2) FROM ratings WHERE game_id=$4) AS average_rating,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ratings WHERE game_id=$5) AS ratings_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE game_id=$6 AND parent_id IS NULL) AS reviews_count,
  (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_seconds) FROM play_sessions WHERE game_id=$7 AND duration_seconds>0) AS median_seconds,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM game_events WHERE game_id=$8 AND event_type IN ('game_click','custom_click')) AS clicks,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM game_events WHERE game_id=$9 AND event_type='catalog_click') AS catalog_clicks,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM game_events WHERE game_id=$10 AND event_type='game_open' AND source='external') AS external_referrals,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorites WHERE game_id=$11) AS favorites,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM game_events WHERE game_id=$12 AND event_type='game_shared') AS share_events,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE('u:'||user_id,'g:'||guest_id)) FROM game_events WHERE game_id=$13 AND event_type='game_shared') AS shared_players

34f8b0d1b675e51bbaa19ab738bcf21d38ddfa1a.sourceSql:
INSERT INTO metric_snapshots(period,bucket_at,scope_key,game_id,ccu,daily_players,sessions,total_seconds)
    VALUES('minute',?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(period,bucket_at,scope_key) DO UPDATE SET
    game_id=excluded.game_id,ccu=excluded.ccu,daily_players=excluded.daily_players,sessions=excluded.sessions,total_seconds=excluded.total_seconds
